build: npm run build:offline-verifier -- --out NEW_DIRECTORY; output must not already exist. Exact copied file bytes are pinned by a canonical manifest published last.
includes: static ESM source/data closure and exact manifest
runtimeAssumptions: Trusted external Node.js 22+ runtime, launcher distribution channel and local filesystem/process execution. Authenticate the launcher separately and obtain the manifest digest independently. Self-hashing is not secure boot, a hostile-host sandbox or protection against check/import filesystem races.
sourceInventory: Build computes the reviewed static ESM and literal new-URL data dependencies. It rejects non-Node external imports, escape paths and unrecognized dynamic import owners. The sole listed dynamic provider owner is unshipped and disabled by the launcher's checker-kind policy. This source scan is not a general JavaScript security proof or a complete operating-system TCB inventory.
launcher: Only Node built-ins load before the expected manifest hash and bounded declared file hashes are checked. Paths are constrained; symlink files/ancestor directories, malformed descriptors, missing files and changed bytes fail closed. Core checker policy is rejected before provider construction.
focusedEvidence: An actual distribution was generated (18 files, approximately 95 KB at this checkpoint) and executed from a separate temporary directory with no compiler or node_modules. It replayed a real supported binary certificate and V1 lock, rejected a wrong manifest pin, modified checker source and an unshipped Core provider. These are focused implementation checks, not global formal assurance.
